title: Combine two consecutive enthalpies
statement:
For $\ce{A -> B}$ the heat is $-[$a]$ kJ, and for $\ce{B -> C}$ it is $+[$b]$ kJ. Find the heat for $\ce{C -> A}$.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Reversing the net equation reverses its heat.

hints: Sum the steps for A to C.
Identify whether the target is forward or reverse.
Reversing the net equation reverses its heat.
solution: The forward path has $-[$a]+[$b]$ kJ. Reverse the entire path to obtain $[$a]-[$b]$ kJ.
